title: Add regression tests that fail when find, aggregate or export return unmasked fields
description: Extend tests/integration/tools/mongodb/read/find.test.ts, aggregate.test.ts, aggregateDB.test.ts and export.test.ts in mongodb-mcp-server. Each test seeds a collection listed in a test copy of maskingPolicy.json with synthetic PAN, account-number and phone values (synthetic data only, no real client data) and asserts that the tool output, or the export file, contains no clear-text value for redact fields and only the allowed partial form for partial fields. Add a unit test for src/common/masking.ts covering nested documents, arrays and $lookup output. The tests must run in the existing GitHub Actions workflow so the PR cannot merge while they fail.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm test on the PR branch passes with the new masking tests, and they fail when maskDocuments is stubbed to return its input unchanged
The GitHub Actions run on the PR shows the masking tests executed and green
No test fixture contains real client data (seed values are synthetic and generated in the test file)

verificationMethod.description: A reviewer other than the author checks the PR diff: tests exist for find, aggregate, aggregateDB and export; a mutation (maskDocuments returning input unchanged) makes them fail; and CI is green on the final commit. Expected result: reviewer approval recorded on the PR.

rootCause.description: The read-tool integration tests assert result shape and limits but never check data classification, so unmasked output could not be caught in CI.
